description: This file defines the controller class CurrentVersionDetailsController for handling the current version details view in the OAuth HRM installer upgrade process. It sets up the component for the view and updates the state container with the current screen.

classes.name: CurrentVersionDetailsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the current version details view during the upgrade process in the installer.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component and updates the current screen state before rendering.
